guides.concept: 越域引水與公共原水供應韌性。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Interbasin diversion and resilient raw water supply. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 歷史官方資料列出南化壩高 87.5 m
1994 年公開紀錄：南化主要工程三月完成，七月正式供水
教學假設：本地入流與越域供水；Vlocal=500000 m3/day; Vimport=300000 m3/day; Vsupply=600000 m3/day; Vloss=40000 m3/day; dV=160000 m3/day
教學假設：雙來源保守成分混合；Qlocal=2 m3/s; Clocal=18 mg/L; Qimport=1 m3/s; Cimport=42 mg/L; Cmix=26 mg/L
教學假設：聯通管輸水的抽水能源；rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=1.8 m3/s; Hstatic=45 m; Hloss=12 m; eta=0.78; Pin=rho g Q(Hstatic+Hloss)/eta/1000=1290.39231 kW
factsEn: The official historical account lists Nanhua dam height 87.5 m
1994 documented event: Nanhua main works finish in March and formal supply starts in July
Teaching assumption, Local inflow and imported supply: Vlocal=500000 m3/day; Vimport=300000 m3/day; Vsupply=600000 m3/day; Vloss=40000 m3/day; dV=160000 m3/day
Teaching assumption, Area curve and interval storage: A1=4000000 m2; A2=5000000 m2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)dz/2=9000000 m3
Teaching assumption, Conservative mixing of two sources: Qlocal=2 m3/s; Clocal=18 mg/L; Qimport=1 m3/s; Cimport=42 mg/L; Cmix=26 mg/L
Teaching assumption, Pumping energy in an intertie: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=1.8 m3/s; Hstatic=45 m; Hloss=12 m; eta=0.78; Pin=rho g Q(Hstatic+Hloss)/eta/1000=1290.39231 kW
timeline: 1994　南化主要工程三月完成，七月正式供水
2014　美國墾務局設計標準索引列出滲流章一月版本，屬方法資料年代
2026　本教材核對公開資料並獨立重算假想示例，不是新增工程完工紀錄
timelineEn: 1994 — Nanhua main works finish in March and formal supply starts in July
2014 — The Reclamation standards index lists the January seepage chapter; this dates a methodological reference
2026 — The curriculum checks public evidence and independently recalculates hypothetical examples; this is not a new project completion
codes: 美國墾務局設計標準十三：土石壩
美國墾務局設計標準十四：水壩附屬構造物
codesEn: Reclamation Design Standards No. 13: Embankment Dams
Reclamation Design Standards No. 14: Appurtenant Structures for Dams
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：南化水庫大壩
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Nanhua Dam
guides.concept: 南化課程以跨流域引水、庫容曲線、原水混合和聯通管線為核心，區分集水區產流與可成功導入水庫的水量。壩體超高、泥砂占容、乾旱需求和流量計不確定度接續形成供水風險帳。可靠度與漏水範例使用明示假設，保留共因失效及量測誤差的影響。
guides.conceptEn: Nanhua focuses on interbasin diversion, storage curves, raw-water mixing and connecting pipelines, separating watershed runoff from water actually delivered to storage. Freeboard, sediment occupation, drought demand and meter uncertainty extend this into a supply-risk account. Reliability and leakage examples retain common-cause failures and measurement errors through explicitly stated assumptions.
procedure: 南化的本地集水與甲仙越域引水屬不同來源，應分別記錄實際到庫水量，再與供水及損失相減。來源河川有水不代表全數都能引入，因為輸水能力、時段與其他用水需求各有限制。水量帳以清楚邊界避免重複計算，並保留入庫延遲，不能只用來源地降雨面積推定目的水庫已收到多少水。
庫容不是水面積乘整座壩高，而是面積隨高程積分。相鄰兩個水位的面積可用梯形近似區間體積，這隱含中間面積近似線性變化；若谷地擴寬不均或岸坡轉折，較密高程資料可改善估算。每次地形測量還應保留基準、邊界與淤積年代，否則不同版本差異未必全是沉積造成。
越域與本地原水可能具有不同保守溶質濃度，混合結果由各股溶質質量率加總後除總水量求得。這可討論來源比例對取水水質的影響，但不代表濁度、消毒需求或會沉降反應的成分也必定線性。採樣時間須配合輸水旅行時間，否則即使公式正確也可能比較到不同水團。
跨區聯通管線可增加供水路徑，但若需要抽升就必須付出位能與摩擦耗能。總揚程把地形高差與沿程局部損失加總，輸入電功率再除泵組效率求得。效率應明確包含哪些設備，不能把馬達、泵及變頻損失在不同位置重複扣除，也不能把輸水能耗誤認為實際水量全部被消耗。
兩條供水路徑只有在失效近似獨立時，才可用失效率乘積估算同時失效。共同電源、同一河川污染或相同控制系統可能同時切斷兩路，使表面上的雙路備援效果下降。以條件機率把共因事件與獨立事件分開，可以檢查可靠度假設；數值不是歷史故障統計，也不是供水保證。
土石壩壩頂與水面的高程差是幾何超高，但波浪上爬、風壅水與沉陷可能占用這段距離。把假想餘量逐項扣除可練習垂直基準與符號，不能把結果稱為現地允許水位或安全保證。各項未必同時達峰，實際組合需符合適用設計情境，而且壩頂局部低點比平均高程更相關。
暴雨總雨量乘集水面積是降到地表的水量，還需扣除截留、入滲與暫存才成為逕流。簡化逕流係數把多種過程合併成比例，適合體積敏感度但不能直接給洪峰流量。南化背景下若土壤前期含水不同，同樣降雨可能產生不同逕流，因此係數不是不變材料常數，也不是可引入水庫的保證比例。
可用庫容除以每年淨淤積量得到名目占容年數，這只是固定速率下的比例尺，不是水庫壽命預報。侵蝕事件、壓密、排砂與供水最低水位都會改變可用空間與損失速率。南化背景的教學應把容量曲線年代與年淤積定義寫明，並區分總庫容消失、有效庫容不足及取水口受影響等不同問題。
乾旱時以可用水量除每日需求可得到無入流的靜態續供時間，但水位下降可能使取水能力或水質改變，不能把這個商當作保證供水天數。需求削減也要區分可實現的節水與只是帳面假設。比較不同需求情境時應使用同一有效庫存邊界，保留不能動用的水量，而非把總庫容全部拿來相除。
聯通管路進出水量之差可提示漏失或暫存，但量測誤差也能形成殘差。若兩個流量計誤差獨立，以平方和開根號合成不確定度，再將殘差除以該尺度可比較訊號大小。這個比值不是漏水機率；共同校準偏差、旅行延遲或管內儲水改變都可能破壞獨立假設，應先檢查再判讀。
procedureEn: Local catchment inflow and imported water are distinct sources and must be measured as volumes actually received before subtracting supply and losses. Water present in a source river is not necessarily transferable because capacity, timing and competing needs constrain delivery. Explicit boundaries and travel delay prevent double counting; rainfall over a source area cannot by itself establish how much water has already reached the destination reservoir.

Storage is the integral of water area over elevation, not one area multiplied by total dam height. Trapezoidal integration between adjacent levels assumes approximately linear area variation. Abrupt valley widening or bank changes require finer elevation spacing. Survey datum, coverage and date must also remain explicit, because differences between capacity-curve versions do not necessarily arise entirely from deposited sediment or represent the same geometric boundary.

Imported and local raw water may contain different concentrations of a conservative dissolved constituent. The blend follows summed solute mass flux divided by total flow. This illustrates source-proportion effects but does not guarantee linear mixing of turbidity, disinfectant demand or settling and reactive constituents. Sampling must account for travel time, otherwise a correct equation can be compared with measurements of different water parcels and appear inconsistent.

A connecting pipeline adds a supply path but requires energy when water must be lifted against elevation and hydraulic losses. Total head combines static lift with distributed and local losses, and electrical input divides hydraulic power by pump-set efficiency. The efficiency boundary must identify included equipment so motor, pump and drive losses are not deducted twice, while energy consumption must remain distinct from physical water loss.

Two supply paths benefit from multiplying failure probabilities only when failures are approximately independent. Shared electricity, source contamination or control systems can disable both paths together and reduce apparent redundancy. A conditional-probability model separates a common-cause event from otherwise independent failures, exposing the assumption behind a reliability estimate. Its numbers are hypothetical, not historical outage statistics or a guarantee that supply will remain available during an actual event.

Geometric freeboard is the elevation difference between crest and water, but wave runup, wind setup and settlement may use part of that distance. Subtracting assumed allowances teaches datum and sign conventions rather than establishing a permitted level or safety guarantee. Peaks need not coincide, actual combinations require an applicable design scenario, and local low crest points matter more than an average elevation when assessing possible overtopping.

Rain depth times catchment area gives precipitation volume, while interception, infiltration and storage reduce runoff. A simplified runoff coefficient combines these processes for volume sensitivity but does not directly produce peak discharge. Antecedent soil moisture can make identical storms yield different runoff, so the coefficient is not an immutable material constant or a guaranteed fraction that can actually be diverted into the reservoir.

Available storage divided by annual net deposition gives a nominal occupation horizon under constant rate, not a reservoir-life forecast. Erosion events, consolidation, sediment removal and minimum supply level change both usable space and loss rate. The storage-curve date and deposition definition must remain explicit, while loss of gross capacity, inadequate usable storage and interference with an intake are distinct outcomes rather than interchangeable meanings of reservoir lifetime.

Usable water divided by daily demand gives a no-inflow static duration, but falling level can change intake capacity or quality, so the quotient is not guaranteed supply time. Demand reduction must distinguish achievable savings from an accounting assumption. Scenarios need the same usable-storage boundary and should retain unavailable water rather than dividing gross reservoir capacity by demand and ignoring physical access constraints.

The difference between pipeline input and output may indicate leakage or storage, but measurement error also creates residuals. Independent meter uncertainties combine by root sum of squares, allowing residual magnitude to be compared with an uncertainty scale. The ratio is not a leakage probability; shared calibration bias, travel delay and changing pipe storage can violate the assumptions and must be examined before interpreting the imbalance as physical loss.
evidence: 將越域水量減半並重算，再把一天拆成兩個時段分別設定引水中斷與恢復，檢查總量及時段最低蓄量，說明日平均可能隱藏的變化。
令中點面積比線性插值大百分之十，使用辛普森式重算並與九百萬立方公尺比較，解釋差異來自曲線形狀而不是新增入庫水量。
保持總流量三立方公尺每秒，把高濃度來源改為一半，再重算濃度並畫來源比例關係，指出哪些水質成分不適合用這條直線預測。
將損失水頭增至十八公尺，保持流量與效率重算，再把效率降至零點七，分別比較兩種因素對耗電的影響，避免將所有變化歸因於泵老化。
把共因機率減半重算，另把其中一路獨立失效機率減半比較改善幅度，說明為何先處理共用設備有時比再增加單一路徑可靠度更有效。
evidenceEn: Halve imported volume and recalculate, then split the day into interruption and recovery intervals. Compare total volume and minimum interim storage to show what a daily average can conceal.

Set midpoint area ten percent above linear interpolation, use Simpson integration and compare with nine million cubic metres. Explain that the difference arises from curve shape rather than additional incoming water.

Keep total flow at three cubic metres per second, halve the high-concentration source contribution and recalculate the blend. Plot source fraction and identify water-quality variables that should not be predicted using this straight line.

Raise loss head to eighteen metres at unchanged flow and efficiency, then reduce efficiency to zero point seven. Compare the two effects separately rather than attributing every energy increase to pump aging.

Halve common-cause probability and recalculate, then separately halve one route's independent failure probability. Compare improvements and explain why addressing a shared dependency can sometimes matter more than improving one individual path.
pitfalls: 把來源河川流量直接當目的水庫入流會忽略未引走水量；若引水停止卻仍使用長期平均值，短期蓄量估算可能保持正值而實際已接近持平或下降。
把兩來源濃度直接平均會在流量不等時偏差；若中間發生沉降或反應，質量不守恆的表象可能反映模型邊界漏掉過程，而非一定是流量計壞掉。
直接把兩條路的失效機率相乘會漏掉共因；反之將已含共同事件的總失效率再加入共因項，會重複計算，讓保守外觀掩蓋不一致的機率定義。
把總逕流體積當作瞬時流量會遺失時間尺度；若忽略暴雨前土壤已飽和，固定係數可能低估產流，反之乾土情境又可能高估，必須保留假設方向。
把百分之十五節水誤讀成續供天數也增加百分之十五，忽略倒數關係；若實際需求沒有達標，仍用假設削減後需求外推，就會把政策目標當成已實現的供水能力。
pitfallsEn: Treating source-river flow as destination inflow ignores water not diverted. Retaining a long-term import average during an interruption can predict growing storage even when the short-term balance is nearly zero or negative.

A simple arithmetic mean is biased when source flows differ. If settling or reaction occurs between samples, an apparent flux imbalance may indicate omitted processes rather than necessarily a failed flow meter.

Multiplying route failure probabilities alone misses common cause. Conversely, adding common cause to route probabilities that already include it double counts events, producing a conservative-looking but internally inconsistent probability model.

Treating runoff volume as instantaneous discharge removes the timescale. A fixed coefficient may underestimate runoff after prior saturation or overestimate it for dry soil, so interpretation must retain the assumed antecedent condition.

A fifteen-percent demand reduction does not increase duration by exactly fifteen percent because duration is inversely related to demand. Using an unrealized reduction treats a policy target as achieved supply performance.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 黑部水壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「本地入流與越域供水」與「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；黑部水壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Local inflow and imported supply" and "Catchment storm runoff volume" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Kurobe Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦越域引水與公共原水供應韌性；黑部水壩則以高山拱壩承載與高水頭水能系統為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on interbasin diversion and resilient raw water supply; Kurobe Dam centres on mountain arch action and high head energy systems, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「本地入流與越域供水」與「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到黑部水壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「快速流速變化與水錘」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Local inflow and imported supply” and “Snowmelt pulses and storage”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Kurobe Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rapid velocity change and water hammer", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 南化水庫大壩
history.text: 水利署歷史文章區分一九九三年七月開始蓄水、一九九四年三月主要工程完成與同年七月正式供水，並列出壩高八十七點五公尺的分區土石壩。甲仙越域引水是供水背景，不表示本課使用現行取水權限或時刻表。文章內當時預測的後續工程日期沒有當成已實現事件引用。課程使用墾務局公開索引作容量計算、滲流及量測研究入口；與黑部的比較只針對水量與能量的不同用途。
history.textEn: The WRA history separates initial impoundment in July 1993, completion of main works in March 1994 and formal supply in July 1994, and lists an 87.5 m zoned embankment. Jiaxian diversion establishes supply context without providing current abstraction permissions or schedules. Later predicted dates in that historical article are not represented as completed events. Public Reclamation indexes offer entry points for capacity, seepage and measurement study. Comparison with Kurobe concerns different uses of water and energy rather than equivalent operating conditions.
